text:
marta: Hey @devex quickstart hit a wall — sample-app's first API call returns 'billing_required' and the SDK errors out. Portal shows the workspace but billing page is kinda ambiguous. anyone seen this?

onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood! We've created workspace 'acme-test'. Note: paid endpoints require linking a payment method at console.redwood.ai/billing. (automated)

devon: Can you paste the exact curl you ran and the Node snippet that failed?

marta: curl works: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 200. Node SDK fails with 402. Log: `Error: Payment required (402) workspace_not_billed`.

samir: My guess: two different keys. The sample-app uses env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but your shell has `REDWOOD_KEY`. SDK reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. Try `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY` and rerun.

marta: That actually fixed the Node run :facepalm: Thanks. Still odd tho — portal shows "No payment required" for my org but the SDK returned 402 earlier.

devon: 402s can come from workspace-level gating when the workspace isn't attached to the org billing account. Curl succeeding suggests you used a personal dev key vs the workspace key in the SDK. Can you check Console -> API keys and confirm which key is pinned in the repo?

marta: Yup — I had a personal key in my shell and a workspace key in the repo env. Updated README to call this out.

devex: Good catch. Action items: update the quickstart to (1) prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in examples, (2) log which env var was picked at startup, and (3) make 402 messages more specific ("workspace requires billing link") instead of generic. We'll file a ticket.

marta: Also noticed the Docker sample's ENTRYPOINT hides env when running via docker-compose on mac (seems to drop env-file). Tripped me up — I opened a small PR in the sample repo.

onboarding-bot: Created ticket #4287: "quickstart: clarify env var names and descriptive 402 errors"

samir: cc @docs — can you add a quick troubleshooting FAQ: multiple keys, workspace vs personal tokens, and env-var name mismatch?

docs: Will do, adding a snippet to detect missing `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and a short runbook.

marta: First successful call now! :tada: Thanks everyone.
